title: Kim Ford
seoTitle: Kim Ford - Accredited Family Law Specialist
description: Kim has been in practice for over 39 years and has experience in all aspects of family law, including de facto and same sex relationships.
html:
Kim is an experienced family lawyer having been in practice for over 39 years. Kim has comprehensive experience in all aspects of family law, including de facto and same sex relationships. In addition to the traditional areas of divorce, parenting, maintenance, child support and property matters, Kim advises on the preparation of financial agreements, complex corporate structures and estate planning, as well as bringing experience in international property and parenting matters.

Kim is an advocate for approaching family law matters via mediation and collaboration whenever possible, seeking to achieve resolution in the most cost effective and timely manner possible for your circumstances.

Although Kim’s focus is always to promote an amicable resolution, there are times when this is not possible. When litigation is required, Kim will be a strong advocate for you and is able to draw on her wealth of experience to support you through the process and represent your interests in Court professionally and expertly.
Kim is a member of:

  • Law Society of NSW
  • Family Law Section of the Law Council of Australia
  • Australian Institute of Family Law Arbitrators and Mediators
  • Central Sydney Collaborative Forum
  • Australian Association of Collaborative Professionals
  • Collaborative Professionals NSW
  • International Academy of Collaborative Professionals

Her qualifications are:

  • Bachelor of Arts and Bachelor of Laws (BA/LLB) degree
  • Admitted as a lawyer to the Supreme Court of NSW
  • Admitted as a lawyer to the High Court of Australia
  • Accredited Specialist in Family Law
  • Accredited Family Law Mediator
